sources.name: value_research
sources.notes: Daily NAV update CSVs from Value Research. VR sends to vr@thegoldstandard.in (NOT the default operations@ mailbox), so the source declares an explicit mailbox override; _run_email_fetch fans out a separate Graph query for that mailbox. Files NAVUpdate-DDMMYYYY-N.csv where DDMMYYYY = the receipt day (the day VR mailed the file). NAV date = DDMMYYYY - 1 (NAVs are for the previous day). N starts at 1 for the morning batch and increments for additional intra-day pushes. The Workflows hub's NAV upload step routes each file from raw/value_research/{receipt_date}/ to raw/value_research/{nav_date}/ before uploading to WS Map ID 46 (source MFVR_NAV_map); per-day bod_log.json tracks which files have been posted so intra-day re-runs only push the new ones. Other attachments from this sender (Debt Sheet, Dividend Update, etc.) land in raw/value_research/{receipt_date}/ for audit but are not consumed by the BOD pipeline.

sources.name: vidal
sources.display_name: Vidal Solutions — EoD Prices & Corp Actions
sources.notes: T0 EoD price + corporate-action files from Vidal Solutions. Sender support@vidalsolutions.com mails to vidal@thegoldstandard.in (NOT the default operations@ mailbox). Each attachment is a zip named XXDDMMYY.zip where XX is a 2-char code (XC=corp action, WY=BSE prices, WE=NSE prices, plus other types we don't currently consume) and DDMMYY is the trading date (= receipt date — Vidal is T0, no day shift). Zips are NOT password-protected and contain a single CSV with the same name as the zip. Files arrive every working day after 6 pm; the EoD pipeline runs ~6:30 pm. Without keep_csv_in_zip, the email_ingestor's holdings-source path skips CSVs extracted from zips (assumes they're misrouted bank statements) — the flag tells it to keep the CSV here so it lands at data/{date}/raw/vidal/XX{ddmmyy}.csv ready for the EoD upload bridges (corp action map 1028, price map 38).
